call_points.text: Rail rake fleet scaled to 78, progressing towards 110 rakes by March 2027.

guidance.statement: FY27 Consolidated Operating Revenue guided at ₹6,850 Cr and Operating EBITDA at ₹3,000 Cr

industry: Services > Transport Services > Logistics Solution Provider

operating_notes.text: Total cargo handled in FY26 stood at 122 million tonnes with 48% third-party mix.
Received ₹48 Cr LOA from Southern Railway for Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal with a 35-year land lease.
Total cargo handled in Q2FY27 stood at 29.4 MT.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹200.77 Cr; net profit ₹13.98 Cr (against a loss of ₹18.53 Cr a year earlier).
JSW Infrastructure reported FY26 revenue of ₹5,361 Cr and operating EBITDA of ₹2,604 Cr, with cargo handling volumes reaching 122 million tonnes.
JSW Infrastructure released its Q4 and FY2026 results presentation, guiding FY27 consolidated operating revenue to ₹6,850 Cr.
JSW Infrastructure Limited, as Ultimate Holding Company, shared the audio recording of the May 08, 2026 Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet via navkarcorp.com.
On May 12, 2026, Navkar Corporation filed the transcript of the earnings conference call held on May 8, 2026.
Navkar Corp received an income tax order granting immunity from penalty for AY2024-25 on May 13, 2026.
JSW Port Logistics Private Limited, as Navkar Corporation Limited’s promoter, declared no encumbrance of shares during FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
Navkar Corporation received a ₹48 Cr letter of acceptance from Southern Railway on October 13, 2026, for a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal.
JSW Infrastructure reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,481 Cr and PAT of ₹328 Cr on 27 October 2026.
JSW Infrastructure Limited, Navkar Corporation Limited’s ultimate holding company, shared the audio recording of its October 27, 2026, conference call via the company’s website.
